title: Long-Horizon Structure-Tracking Growth Law
scientific_question: Across a long structured continual stream whose reusable latent vocabulary itself grows sublinearly, does learned Cell state track latent structure rather than transaction count while spawn probability declines and retention/composition remain usable?
new_integration_variable: long-horizon streaming growth with a continuously expanding reusable latent vocabulary

world.novel_factor_exposure: four unequal-weight pair mixtures with different already-existing anchors; no novelty/factor label is supplied to the learner

learner.bootstrap: reuse Constructive CLM-001B RelationalCellLearner on the initial six-factor mixture block
learner.inference: x-only sparse support inference over current Cell keys, support <= 3
learner.novelty_proposal: for several possible known anchors, solve the registered one-missing-unit-key pair geometry from current x/y residuals
learner.probation: candidate must recur through at least two distinct anchors before commit

posthoc_only_information: hidden factor IDs for alignment/route scoring
true factor count for growth-tracking metrics
registered introduction times for oracle growth curve

controls_and_references.oracle_latent_curve: the true reusable factor count at each registered checkpoint
controls_and_references.anti_cap_guard: learner has no max_cells parameter and must still create a factor near the end of the stream

primary_metrics: heldout pair/triple MSE and route recall at every checkpoint

formal_gates.bootstrap_reused_component_valid: 001B bootstrap valid and produces six initial Cells
formal_gates.state_ratio_declines: K/N at 4096 <= 0.01 and <= 30% of K/N at N=256
formal_gates.spawn_rate_declines: registered window spawn rates are non-increasing up to 15% tolerance
formal_gates.growth_remains_enabled_late: last committed Cell occurs after 90% of the 4096-transaction horizon
formal_gates.coordinate_quality: final mean matched key cosine >= 0.985, effect cosine >= 0.995, with no duplicate factor assignment
formal_gates.composition_quality: final pair/triple MSE <= 0.0005 and route recall >= 0.98
formal_gates.early_factor_retention: final evaluation restricted to the first six factors has pair/triple MSE <= 0.0005 and recall >= 0.98

formal_decision_rule: SUPPORTED only if every formal seed completes and every registered gate is true on every formal seed
positive_interpretation: On the registered 4096-transaction structured stream, Cell state tracks a sublinearly expanding reusable latent vocabulary, K/N and spawn rate decline, late reuse remains high, and learned coordinates preserve controlled composition/retention.
next_if_positive: Constructive CLM-003 certificate integration; CLM-002 should not be extended indefinitely with cosmetic longer synthetic streams.
